findings.claim: SoFi Q3 2026 新增會員紀錄 120 萬，總會員 1,710 萬，年增 35%
findings.excerpt: SoFi grew members 35% year-over-year to 17.1 million, adding a record 1.2 million members during the quarter, while products increased 44% to 26.7 million, including a record 2.2 million products added.

findings.claim: SoFi Q2 2026 總originations $14.8B 創高，個人貸款 $10.7B，含 Loan Platform Business $3.1B；Sixth Street 最高 $10 億個人貸款投資協議
findings.excerpt: SoFi delivered its best quarter ever for total loan originations at $14.8 billion, up more than $2.6 billion from the prior quarter, including record originations across Personal Loans, Student Loans and Home Loans. Personal Loan originations totaled $10.7 billion which included Loan Platform Business originations of $3.1 billion reflecting strong demand from Loan Platform Business
